paras: Calliophis maculiceps, commonly known as the speckled coral snake or the small-spotted coral snake, is a species of venomous elapid snake endemic to Southeast Asia. Five subspecies are recognized, including the nominotypical subspecies.
C. maculiceps is found in Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, and Vietnam.
